answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities: each agent locks a 400-unit deposit for one of 500 capped slots, shown in an atlas with slots marked in ivory. It must send a work pulse each hour, proving real activity. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 400 = 400,000 units, and idle or duplicate slots are burned, not refunded. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot by working, and earns undiluted rewards, so mass forgery stays unprofitable.
